about.page_title: About Vero Ceilings Factory — Industrial Scale Ceiling Manufacturer in Central Asia
about.title: About Vero Ceilings Manufacturing Complex
about.paragraph1: Vero Ceilings is the premier industrial manufacturer of modern metal, mineral, and open-cell suspended ceiling systems in Central Asia, operating as the flagship manufacturing division of Vero Group (established 2014). Our production facility in Tashkent spans over 15,000 m² of modern industrial floor space, equipped with over 200 high-precision automated roll-forming and powder coating machines, supported by a workforce of 1,700+ engineers, technicians, and specialists.
about.paragraph2: We engineer and manufacture the full spectrum of Grilyato open-cell systems (50x50 to 200x200 mm), Armstrong lay-in and clip-in metal cassettes, acoustic gypsum tiles, and architectural linear baffle systems. All products comply with ISO 9001 quality management, international Class A fire safety regulations, and environmental standards, serving projects across all 14 regions of Uzbekistan and exporting to Central Asia, the CIS, and beyond.
about.paragraph3: For international architectural firms, developers, and general contractors, Vero Ceilings provides full technical specification support, rapid sample dispatch, containerized worldwide shipping, and on-site engineering supervision.
about.intro_title: Vero Group Holding — A Decade of Industrial Manufacturing Scale
about.intro_text: Vero Group holding includes over 10 manufacturing enterprises across the building materials sector. We invest continuously in automated European and Asian production machinery, strict metallurgical quality control, and eco-sustainable manufacturing.
about.counter1_text: Over 1,700 dedicated specialists across Vero Group ensuring uncompromising quality and around-the-clock production.
about.counter2_text: More than 200 automated high-speed roll-forming and CNC sheet-metal lines producing millions of square metres annually.
about.counter3_text: Over 120 major construction corporations, international architectural studios, and regional distributors rely on Vero Ceilings.
about.story_title: Vero Ceilings: Manufacturing Infrastructure at Scale
about.story_text: From international airport terminals to commercial shopping malls, corporate banking headquarters, and luxury hotels, Vero Ceilings delivers architectural ceiling solutions with speed, precision, and factory-direct cost efficiency.
about.vision_title: Global Vision: Central Asian Manufacturing Hub
about.vision_text: The Vero manufacturing plant was visited and praised by the President of Uzbekistan, Shavkat Mirziyoyev, highlighting our contribution to industrial export. Vero Ceilings represents Uzbekistan at premier global exhibitions including Aquatherm Tashkent, ShymkentBuild, and MosBuild.

faq.page_title: Frequently Asked Questions: Specifications, Production & Global Export
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

q1.question: What is Vero Ceilings' production scale and manufacturing facility location?
q1.answer: Vero Ceilings operates a 15,000 m² factory complex in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, equipped with 200+ automated machinery lines and employing 1,700+ people across the Vero Group holding. Annual output exceeds millions of square metres of ceiling systems.

q2.question: What export destinations and shipping terms do you support?
q2.answer: We export throughout Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan), the CIS, and the Middle East by truckload (FTL) and ocean containers (FCL). We supply CT-1 certificates of origin, customs export documentation, and flexible Incoterms (FCA, CPT, DAP, FOB, CIF).

q3.question: What certifications and fire safety ratings do your ceilings carry?
q3.answer: All Vero Ceilings systems are manufactured under ISO 9001 quality management and comply with international fire codes (Class A1 / non-combustible НГ ratings), acoustic performance standards, and sanitary safety certifications.

q4.question: Can architects request physical sample kits and BIM/DWG documentation?
q4.answer: Yes! We provide full specifier packages including physical aluminium and metal sample boxes, high-resolution finish swatches, technical DWG details, and BIM/Revit families. Contact our export desk to request a kit.

q5.question: What Grilyato open-cell dimensions and custom finishes are available?
q5.answer: Standard cell sizes include 50x50, 75x75, 100x100, 150x150, and 200x200 mm with blade heights from 30 to 50 mm. Available in standard white, black, metallic grey, and custom RAL powder coatings or wood-sublimated finishes.

q6.question: What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ) and lead times for wholesale export?
q6.answer: High-runner profiles (Grilyato 100x100, 75x75, Armstrong 600x600 in white/black) are maintained in inventory for immediate dispatch. Custom production runs are typically fulfilled within 5 to 14 business days depending on volume.
